name: OpenPort Adaptive Least-Privilege Durable Capability Lease Profile v0.2
summary: Opt-in public reference profile for single-host durable capability-lease consumption, transactional audit obligations, idempotent recovery, and process-isolated SQLite state.
claimBoundary: This profile validates selected single-host behavior of an optional public research adapter. It does not describe or certify Accentrust production architecture, multi-host replication, network partitions, filesystem loss, database correctness, model robustness, or prompt-injection immunity.

runtimeBoundary.adapter: SQLite WAL with synchronous=FULL and BEGIN IMMEDIATE
runtimeBoundary.nodeRequirement: Node.js 22.5 or later for the optional built-in node:sqlite adapter
runtimeBoundary.scope: single host, one SQLite writer protocol, deterministic injected failure points

checks.description: A consuming authorization MUST atomically commit the call/cost decrement, a minimized audit obligation, and an optional lease-scoped idempotency record.
evidence: clean action leaves one committed consumption and one delivered outbox record
fault after lease update but before outbox insertion rolls the transaction back
fault after outbox insertion but before commit rolls the transaction back

checks.description: When commit succeeds but the response is lost, retry with the same explicit idempotency key and the same request fingerprint MUST return the committed lease snapshot without a second decrement; key reuse with a different fingerprint MUST fail closed.
evidence: post-commit injected failure leaves one consumption, one outbox row, and one idempotency row
equivalent retry preserves the committed lease version and budget
same-lease key reuse with a changed request fingerprint returns agent.idempotency_mismatch without another consumption or audit obligation

checks.description: Audit delivery MUST use a stable event identifier and an idempotent sink so failure before outbox acknowledgement does not duplicate evidence.
evidence: fault before delivered marking recovers to one audit event
fault after marking but before commit recovers to one audit event
outbox pending count converges to zero

checks.description: Lease state and revocation MUST survive reconstruction of the public reference runtime around the same durable adapter.
evidence: active lease is readable after adapter reopen
committed revocation remains effective after a second reopen

checks.description: Concurrent distinct proposals against one remaining call MUST yield exactly one consumption, while same-key proposals MUST reuse one lease-scoped idempotency record.
evidence: 32 distinct proposals yield one success and 31 call-budget denials
16 same-key proposals yield one budget decrement and one durable audit event
same-key replay requires an equal hashed request fingerprint
the same key under a second lease produces an independent consumption

checks.description: The durable outbox and idempotency tables MUST store request digests and bounded decision metadata rather than raw tasks, requests, policies, credentials, or private topology.
evidence: request and idempotency identifiers and replay-equivalence fingerprints are hashed before persistence
durable audit events carry explicit raw-content omission flags
